summary: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting routine monthly NAV-based offering prices for its Class I, S, and D shares as of July 31, 2026, declared regular distributions payable September 29, 2026, and provided a standard portfolio update. The filing contains no transaction, strategic event, or special situation; it is purely an informational update typical of a closed-end fund. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. This is a routine current report and does not qualify as a special situation.
